name: kolo-tontine-app
description: Kolo — Tontine collective simplifiée. FastAPI backend + React/Vite frontend.

scripts.backend: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && uvicorn app.main:app --reload
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python3 -m venv venv && source venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.install:all: npm run install:frontend && npm run install:backend
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && alembic upgrade head
scripts.db:revision: cd backend && source venv/bin/activate && alembic revision --autogenerate -m

author: Ibrahim Abah
